payload.name: Social Bee by HYVE
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Social Bee helps registered teams plan, create, review, schedule, publish, and measure brand-scoped social content while respecting each user's tenant, brand, role, plan, Brand Kit, and connected-account permissions.
payload.longDescription: Social Bee 帮助已注册的团队规划、创建、审核、安排发布、发布并衡量品牌范围内的社交内容，同时遵守每位用户的租户、品牌、角色、套餐、Brand Kit 以及已连接账户的权限。

payload.name: VerticalResponse
payload.description: 联系人、列表与电子邮件
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: VerticalResponse helps users search contacts, inspect contact details, manage contact lists, sample random contacts, export sanitized contact data, create and update draft email campaigns, send test emails, launch or schedule campaigns with explicit confirmation, and review email campaign performance from ChatGPT. The app supports a deterministic OAuth review demo account, uses explicit validated inputs for contact and campaign fields, never exposes credentials or raw API responses, and does not implement delete tools for campaigns, contacts, or lists.
payload.longDescription: VerticalResponse 帮助用户在 ChatGPT 中搜索联系人、查看联系人详情、管理联系人列表、抽样随机联系人、导出经过清理的联系人数据、创建和更新电子邮件营销活动草稿、发送测试邮件、经明确确认后启动或安排营销活动，以及查看邮件营销活动表现。该应用支持确定性的 OAuth 审核演示账户；联系人和营销活动字段均使用明确且经过验证的输入；绝不暴露凭据或原始 API 响应；并且不提供删除营销活动、联系人或列表的工具。

payload.name: Whoovia
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Real estate agents and staff members within organizations can create and manage buyers for themselves or for agents on their team. Agents can also look up buyer and agent records by name and make updates.

Whoovia makes buyer profiles easier to manage, discover, and match within the real estate market. 

Try prompts like: 
• Create a buyer profile for Ethan Brooks looking in McLean, VA for a single-family, 4 bed / 3 bath, budget $1.2M, move-in within the next 3–6 months. Conventional loan, approved.
• Update Ethan Brooks' profile — set budget to $900,000 and location to Alexandria, VA. 
• Create a profile for Alex Morgan under agent Jamie Chen, looking in San Diego, CA — 4 bed / 3 bath, $1.2M budget, cash buyer, move-in within the next 2–5 months.
• Pull up the profile for Chris Walker.
payload.longDescription:
房地产机构内的经纪人和员工可以为自己或团队经纪人创建和管理购房者。经纪人还可以按姓名查找购房者和经纪人记录并进行更新。

Whoovia 让房地产市场中的购房者档案更易管理、查找和匹配。

可以尝试以下提示：
• 为 Ethan Brooks 创建购房者档案：他在弗吉尼亚州 McLean 寻找独栋住宅，4 卧 3 卫，预算 $1.2M，希望在未来 3–6 个月内入住。传统贷款，已获批。
• 更新 Ethan Brooks 的档案——将预算设为 $900,000，地点改为弗吉尼亚州 Alexandria。
• 为 Alex Morgan 创建档案，归属经纪人 Jamie Chen；他在加利福尼亚州 San Diego 寻找房屋，4 卧 3 卫，预算 $1.2M，现金买家，希望在未来 2–5 个月内入住。
• 调出 Chris Walker 的档案。

payload.name: Gastrosync
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Gastrosync helps catering and hospitality teams turn inquiries into events, manage clients, products, packing lists, operational details, offers, agreements, invoices, and reporting, and safely maintain approved product-library data.
payload.longDescription: Gastrosync 帮助餐饮和酒店接待团队将咨询转化为活动，管理客户、产品、打包清单、运营细节、报价、协议、发票和报告，并安全维护已批准的产品库数据。

payload.name: Beentry
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Beentry connects your beekeeping records to ChatGPT. Ask about your apiaries, hives, inspections, queens, tasks, honey harvests, finances and nearby-disease alerts in plain language — and log new inspections, tasks or harvests just by chatting. Every change is confirmed before it happens, deletions are reversible, and the assistant only ever sees data from your own signed-in Beentry account.
payload.longDescription: Beentry将你的养蜂记录连接到ChatGPT。用日常语言询问蜂场、蜂箱、检查、蜂王、任务、蜂蜜收获、财务和附近疾病预警，并且只需聊天即可记录新的检查、任务或收获。每项更改都在执行前确认，删除可以撤销，助手只能看到你已登录的Beentry账户中的数据。

payload.name: Pace
payload.description: 掌握每笔交易的实时背景
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Pace is the context layer for your sales pipeline. It pre-computes deal intelligence from your CRM, emails, and call recordings, then serves it to your AI assistant as live, structured context on every deal. Ask what's really going on with an account, get AI risk and forecast assessments backed by evidence, catch deals that have gone quiet, and know precisely where your team is going to land. No more digging through Salesforce or HubSpot, no more guessing.
payload.longDescription: Pace 是销售管道的上下文层。它会从 CRM、电子邮件和通话录音中预先计算交易情报，然后将每笔交易的实时结构化上下文提供给 AI 助手。你可以询问某个客户账户的真实情况，获取有证据支持的 AI 风险和预测评估，发现陷入停滞的交易，并准确了解团队最终业绩。无需再翻查 Salesforce 或 HubSpot，也不必猜测。

payload.name: Relay Tow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Relay Tow gives towing providers a conversational view of their operations. Look up active dispatches, check which drivers are on call, review driver performance, pull invoices and impound records, calculate charges against your rate cards, and generate reports — without leaving the chat.
payload.longDescription: Relay Tow 以对话方式展示拖车服务商的运营情况。无需离开聊天即可查询当前派单、查看哪些司机值班、审查司机绩效、调取发票和扣押记录、按费率卡计算费用并生成报告。

payload.name: Proprietio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Proprietio connects ChatGPT to a property management portfolio so users can review operations, accounting, maintenance, and owner reporting in one place. It can generate a daily operations brief, command center, portfolio risk radar, and owner update; look up properties, units, leases, residents, rent roll, NOI, delinquency, income statement, balance sheet, and general ledger; manage work orders; browse approved vendors; and message residents or vendors. It is built for property managers, owners, and accounting teams who want to identify priorities and take routine actions without leaving ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription:
该插件房产运营与会计。以下功能和限制适用：
Proprietio connects ChatGPT to a property management portfolio so users can review operations, accounting, maintenance, and owner reporting in one place. It can generate a daily operations brief, command center, portfolio risk radar, and owner update; look up properties, units, leases, residents, rent roll, NOI, delinquency, income statement, balance sheet, and general ledger; manage work orders; browse approved vendors; and message residents or vendors. It is built for property managers, owners, and accounting teams who want to identify priorities and take routine actions without leaving ChatGPT.

payload.name: Conversion
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT to the Conversion marketing data platform to inspect CRM contacts, build emails, audiences, forms, and campaigns, diagnose why a contact did not receive an email or enter a workflow, and audit sync failures with Salesforce and other connected systems. Read-only tools cover contacts, opportunities, campaigns, forms, workflows, sync logs, and email performance metrics. Write tools create blast emails, audiences, campaigns, folders, contacts, and CSV imports within the user's authenticated Conversion workspace.
payload.longDescription: 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Conversion 营销数据平台，检查 CRM 联系人，创建邮件、受众、表单和活动，诊断联系人为何未收到邮件或未进入工作流，并审计与 Salesforce 及其他连接系统的同步失败。只读工具涵盖联系人、商机、活动、表单、工作流、同步日志和邮件表现指标。写入工具可在用户已认证的 Conversion 工作区中创建群发邮件、受众、活动、文件夹、联系人和 CSV 导入。

payload.name: CampusThreads
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: CampusThreads helps organization administrators run ambassador programs: review operations, coordinate events and shifts, manage tasks and resources, communicate with ambassadors and prospects, and configure their workspace.
payload.longDescription: CampusThreads 帮助组织管理员开展大使项目：查看运营情况、协调活动和班次、管理任务和资源、与大使及潜在成员沟通，并配置工作空间。

payload.name: Kreel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Kreel connects ChatGPT to normalized ecommerce performance data from Shopify, Klaviyo, Meta Ads, and Google Ads. Users ask about revenue, ROAS, campaigns, creatives, email performance, and anomalies across their connected brands, keep a durable brand knowledge base, and publish hosted reports on request.
payload.longDescription: Kreel 将 ChatGPT 连接到来自 Shopify、Klaviyo、Meta Ads 和 Google Ads 的标准化电商表现数据。用户可以用自然语言询问收入、ROAS、营销活动、创意素材、邮件表现和异常情况，维护持久的品牌知识库，并按需发布托管报告。

payload.name: LinkupAPI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Automate your outreach across B2B channels, right from your GPT. Find prospects, research people and companies, personalize and send your messages, send connection requests, and read your inbox and replies, all from your own connected accounts.
payload.longDescription: 直接从你的 GPT 自动开展跨 B2B 渠道的外联。通过自己已连接的账户寻找潜在客户、研究个人和公司、个性化并发送消息、发送连接请求，以及阅读收件箱和回复。

payload.name: Archive
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Archive helps teams search workspace social content and creators, inspect campaigns, saved views, collections, operations, and webhooks, and manage those workspace records through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Archive 帮助团队搜索工作区中的社交内容和创作者，查看营销活动、已保存视图、内容集、操作和 webhook，并通过 ChatGPT 管理这些工作区记录。

payload.name: Yolando
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Yolando spots emerging trends, connects the dots, and moves before the market – or your competitors – see it coming.

Connect your Yolando workspace to ask, in plain language, how ChatGPT and other AI assistants describe your business, where you're cited and where you're not, and how your visibility compares to your competitors'. Pull citation and reputation trends, track competitor movements, and get a prioritized list of what to create, optimize, or fix — all from your own workspace data, right inside the conversation.

Requires a Yolando account.
payload.longDescription:
Yolando 能发现新兴趋势、串联线索，并在市场或竞争对手察觉之前采取行动。

连接 Yolando 工作区后，你可以用日常语言询问 ChatGPT 和其他 AI 助手如何描述你的业务、在哪些地方引用或未引用你，以及你的可见度与竞争对手相比如何。查看引用和声誉趋势、跟踪竞争对手动向，并获取按优先级排列的待创建、优化或修复事项——所有内容都来自你自己的工作区数据，直接呈现在对话中。

需要 Yolando 账户。

payload.name: Famulor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Famulor lets users inspect existing AI assistant configurations, saved versions, available models, languages, voices, and past conversation history in their authenticated workspace. This read-only directory profile cannot create or change assistants, start calls, send messages, launch campaigns, purchase phone numbers, or open billing flows.
payload.longDescription: Famulor 可让用户在已认证的工作区中查看现有 AI 助手配置、保存的版本、可用模型、语言、声音和过往对话记录。此只读目录档案无法创建或更改助手、发起通话、发送消息、启动活动、购买电话号码或打开账单流程。

payload.name: Magnus
payload.description: 面向应用发布商的分析
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Magnus is an analytics platform for mobile and web app publishers. It aggregates marketing spend from ad networks, subscription and in-app revenue, ad-network monetization, payment-provider outcomes and first-party product-analytics events into one place, so a publisher can ask how a campaign, an app or an experiment is actually performing.

Over MCP the app exposes that data read-only. Three tools answer questions: marketing_timeline_report for acquisition and monetization performance (installs, spend, revenue, ROMI, forecasts), finances_risk_report and finances_risk_approval_rates for payment risk (approval rate, refunds, fraud alerts, disputes, chargebacks). A second group answers product-analytics questions from the publisher's own SDK events: event counts, funnels, retention, user-property segments and A/B experiment configuration. Everything else is a lookup helper that exists to feed those tools with real ids, filter values and metric definitions, because app ids, event names and metric semantics are account-specific and cannot be guessed.

Access is scoped to the companies the signed-in user is an active member of, and that membership is re-checked on every single call, so the model can never reach another tenant's data. The OAuth scope the app requests, mcp:analytics.read, grants read access only: no tool in the server can create, update or delete anything.
payload.longDescription:
Magnus 是面向移动和 Web 应用发布商的分析平台。它将广告网络营销支出、订阅和应用内收入、广告网络变现、支付服务商结果以及第一方产品分析事件汇总到一个地方，让发布商可以询问某个活动、应用或实验的真实表现。

该应用通过 MCP 以只读方式提供数据。三个工具用于回答问题：marketing_timeline_report 提供获客和变现表现（安装量、支出、收入、ROMI、预测）；finances_risk_report 和 finances_risk_approval_rates 提供支付风险信息（批准率、退款、欺诈警报、争议、拒付）。另一组工具根据发布商自己的 SDK 事件回答产品分析问题：事件数量、漏斗、留存、用户属性分群和 A/B 实验配置。其他工具都是查找辅助工具，用于为上述工具提供真实 ID、筛选值和指标定义，因为应用 ID、事件名称和指标含义因账户而异，无法猜测。

访问权限限定在已登录用户作为活跃成员所属的公司内，并且每次调用都会重新检查成员资格，因此模型永远无法访问其他租户的数据。应用请求的 OAuth 范围 mcp:analytics.read 仅授予读取权限：服务器中没有任何工具可以创建、更新或删除内容。

payload.name: Nowlun Tracking
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Nowlun turns a Bill of Lading into a live shipment view. Upload the document, or just paste a BL, booking, or container number, and get the current status back in the chat.

Beyond tracking identifiers, it reads the full contents of the BL — shipper and consignee, notify party, cargo description, container numbers and sizes, ports of loading and discharge, vessel and voyage, and commercial terms. So instead of retyping details from a PDF into a portal, you can ask questions about the document directly.

Once the shipment is identified, you get:

Current status and last known milestone
Vessel, voyage, and carrier details
ETD and ETA, with schedule changes when the carrier updates them
Container-level breakdown for multi-container shipments
An interactive map showing the route and where the vessel is now

Useful for freight forwarders, importers and exporters, and anyone who handles shipping documents and wants an answer without logging into three carrier websites.

Nowlun is a digital freight forwarding platform covering sea freight, air cargo, customs clearance, and inland trucking. No account is required to track a shipment.
payload.longDescription:
Nowlun 可将提单转换为实时货运视图。上传文件，或直接粘贴 BL、订舱或集装箱编号，即可在聊天中获取当前状态。

除了追踪标识符，它还会读取 BL 的完整内容——发货人和收货人、通知方、货物描述、集装箱编号及尺寸、装货港和卸货港、船舶与航次，以及商业条款。因此，你无需再把 PDF 中的信息手动录入门户网站，可以直接询问文件内容。

识别货物后，你可以查看：

当前状态和最近已知节点
船舶、航次和承运人详情
ETD 和 ETA，以及承运人更新后的日程变更
多集装箱货运的逐箱明细
显示航线及船舶当前位置的交互式地图

适用于货运代理、进口商、出口商，以及任何需要处理运输文件、希望无需登录三个承运人网站就能获取答案的人。

Nowlun 是一家数字货运代理平台，涵盖海运、空运、清关和内陆卡车运输。追踪货运无需账户。

payload.name: Alvamitra
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Alvamitra membantu pengguna mencari produk CCTV dan perangkat keamanan, melihat stok, spesifikasi, dan rekomendasi produk berdasarkan kebutuhan. Pengguna juga dapat membuka halaman produk atau menghubungi Alvamitra untuk melakukan pemesanan perangkat fisik.
payload.longDescription: Alvamitra 帮助用户查找 CCTV 产品和安防设备，查看库存、规格以及基于需求的产品推荐。用户还可以打开产品页面或联系 Alvamitra，订购实体设备。

payload.name: Dukkani
payload.description: 浏览你的 Dukkani 商店
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Dukkani store to ChatGPT to securely explore products, inventory, orders, customers, and other permitted store information through a central read-only connection.
payload.longDescription: 将你的 Dukkani 商店连接到 ChatGPT，通过统一的只读连接安全地查看产品、库存、订单、客户和其他获准访问的商店信息。

payload.name: Faida Load Check
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Faida helps owner-operators and small carriers sanity-check load offers and delay claims before they commit. Enter lane, mileage, offer, fuel, hours, readiness, broker trust, or detention facts; Faida returns cost-based guidance, caveats, and concise broker wording. It is a decision aid, not a load board or paperwork intake.
payload.longDescription: Faida 帮助个体卡车司机和小型承运商在接受前核算运输报价和延误索赔是否合理。输入线路、里程、报价、燃油、工时、准备情况、经纪商可信度或滞留时间等信息；Faida 会提供基于成本的建议、注意事项和简洁的经纪商沟通措辞。它是决策辅助工具，不是货运信息平台，也不用于接收文书。

payload.name: CedarAI Data Depot
payload.description: 通过 Cedar 登录访问 ARMS 数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Read-only access to Cedar ARMS railroad data for the signed-in user: inventory, work orders, waybill-adjacent records, charges, invoices, quotes, notes, and related lookups. Mutations belong in the ARMS UI. Users authenticate with their Cedar login.
payload.longDescription: 已登录用户可只读访问 Cedar ARMS 铁路数据：库存、工单、运单相关记录、费用、发票、报价、备注及相关查询。数据变更应在 ARMS 界面中进行。用户使用 Cedar 登录信息进行身份验证。

payload.name: Meistron
payload.description: 通过 AI 管理订单和发票
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Meistron ist die Betriebssoftware für Handwerksbetriebe. Über den KI-Zugang verbindet ein Betrieb ChatGPT mit seinen Daten und kann Aufträge, Rechnungen, Angebote, Material, Arbeitszeiten und ausgewählte Einstellungen abfragen und pflegen. Die Rechte sind je Bereich auf aus, lesen oder schreiben einstellbar; Außenwirkungen werden separat freigegeben. Der Zugang löst keinen Briefversand aus, gibt keine Bankverbindung oder Zahlungsanweisung aus und löscht keine Datensätze. Der Rechnungsversand per E-Mail verlangt zusätzlich eine Zwei-Schritt-Bestätigung. Anmeldung und Zustimmung erfolgen über OAuth 2.1 mit PKCE.
payload.longDescription: Meistron 是手工业企业的运营软件。企业通过 AI 入口将 ChatGPT 连接到自身数据后，可以查询和维护订单、发票、报价、材料、工时和选定设置。各领域的权限可分别设置为关闭、读取或写入；对外影响另行授权。该入口不会触发信件寄送，不会显示银行账户信息或付款指令，也不会删除数据记录。通过电子邮件发送发票还需要额外的两步确认。登录和同意通过 OAuth 2.1 与 PKCE 完成。

payload.name: Motive Admin
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The plugin enables Motive dealer customers to manage their website directly inside of ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 此插件可让 Motive 经销商客户直接在 ChatGPT 中管理其网站。

payload.name: Jeep
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Jeep
payload.longDescription: 吉普（Jeep）

payload.name: Arne Kellmann
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Read Arne Kellmann's published AI architecture consulting services, compare engagement types and find scope, pricing and contact guidance. Search published documents with source URLs and excerpts. English and German catalogs are available. All four consulting services cost EUR 120 per hour excluding VAT; scope and availability require individual agreement. Public information access is free. This plugin does not book appointments, send enquiries or take payments.
payload.longDescription: 阅读Arne Kellmann已发布的AI架构咨询服务，比较合作类型，并查找服务范围、定价和联系指引。搜索已发布文档，获取来源URL和摘录。提供英语和德语目录。所有四项咨询服务均按每小时EUR 120收费，不含增值税；范围和可用时间需单独协商。访问公开信息免费。该插件不预约、不发送咨询，也不收取付款。

payload.name: Scoutee
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Scoutee searches public procurement notices published by official journals and buyer platforms across Europe and North America, refreshed every morning. Ask for tenders by keywords, countries and estimated value, compare buyers and deadlines, then open one notice to read its procedure, CPV codes and an excerpt. Every result links to the notice's public page on scoutee.org; the full description, the buyer's platform, the tender documents, email alerts and the AI analysis come with a free Scoutee account.
payload.longDescription: Scoutee 搜索欧洲和北美官方公报及采购方平台发布的公共采购公告，每天早晨更新。按关键词、国家和预估金额查找招标，比较采购方和截止日期，然后打开公告查看流程、CPV 代码和摘要。每条结果都链接到 scoutee.org 上的公告公开页面；完整说明、采购方平台、招标文件、电子邮件提醒和 AI 分析需使用免费的 Scoutee 账户。

payload.name: Znajdź Przetargi
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The ZnajdzPrzetargi.pl tender search engine is a tool that enables quick and convenient searching of current tenders. It searches for private tenders, public tenders, and public procurement opportunities in Poland. Thanks to advanced filters, users can precisely tailor the results to their needs, for example by industry, location, or specific details of the contract.
payload.longDescription: ZnajdzPrzetargi.pl 招标搜索引擎是一款可快速、便捷查找当前招标信息的工具。它会搜索波兰的私人招标、公共招标和公共采购机会。借助高级筛选条件，用户可以按行业、地点或合同的具体信息精确调整结果。

payload.name: Nuboo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Nuboo helps real estate advisors search projects and available lots, review lot details, compare financing options and active promotions, create property and investment quotes with downloadable PDFs, manage prospects, schedule follow-up events, and review authorized sales information from their connected Nuboo account.
payload.longDescription: Nuboo 帮助房地产顾问搜索项目和可售地块，查看地块详情，比较融资选项和当前促销，创建可下载 PDF 的房产及投资报价，管理潜在客户，安排跟进事件，并查看其已连接 Nuboo 账户中获授权的销售信息。

payload.name: BetterMenu
payload.description: 根据配方生成 FDA 标签
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
BetterMenu keeps recipe formulation, nutrition analysis and FDA labeling in one versioned system, so compliance stops being a separate project at the end of development.

Search standard and branded ingredients, resolve kitchen measures to gram weights, and calculate per-serving and per-container nutrition against the FDA reference values in 21 CFR 101. Add custom ingredients with your own nutrition data, set serving sizes, and export the Nutrition Facts label.

Every recipe is versioned: reformulate freely, then see which ingredient change moved which nutrient, and which version any given label came from. Values carry their source, so you can answer where a number came from without reconstructing it.

For food manufacturers, co-packers, and R&D and regulatory teams working on packaged food sold in the United States.
payload.longDescription:
BetterMenu 将配方设计、营养分析和 FDA 标签管理集中在一个有版本记录的系统中，让合规工作不再成为开发末期的独立项目。

搜索标准及品牌食材，将厨房计量单位转换为克重，并依据 21 CFR 101 中的 FDA 参考值计算每份和每容器的营养成分。使用自己的营养数据添加自定义食材，设置份量，并导出营养成分标签。

每个配方都有版本记录：自由调整配方，然后查看哪项食材变动改变了哪种营养素，以及每张标签来自哪个版本。数值附带来源，让你无需重新推算就能说明数字出处。

适合食品制造商、代工包装商，以及从事美国市场包装食品工作的研发和法规团队。

payload.name: Semji
payload.description: 规划并评估 SEO 内容
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Semji is a content platform for marketing teams. This app gives access to the Semji workspaces a user already belongs to, so an editorial pipeline can be driven in conversation: browse the content pipeline with the same filters as the app, add drafts to the planning in bulk from titles and focus keywords, run SEO and GEO keyword analyses, and read the resulting Content Score with typed recommendations per surface (Google Search, Google AI Overview, ChatGPT). Optional AI drafting is available and always lands in a review state first, so nothing is written to a draft without an explicit confirmation. Access follows the user's own Semji permissions: they reach only the workspaces their account already has, with the role they already hold there, and every call is authorised server-side against the organization their token belongs to.
payload.longDescription: Semji 是面向营销团队的内容平台。此应用可访问用户已加入的 Semji 工作区，让用户通过对话管理编辑流程：使用与应用相同的筛选条件浏览内容流程；根据标题和重点关键词批量将草稿添加到规划中；运行 SEO 和 GEO 关键词分析；并查看 Content Score 及针对各个平台（Google Search、Google AI Overview、ChatGPT）的分类建议。可选的 AI 起草功能始终先将内容置于待审核状态，因此未经明确确认不会写入草稿。访问权限遵循用户在 Semji 中已有的权限：用户只能访问其账户原本有权进入的工作区，并保留在那里已有的角色；每次调用都会在服务器端根据其令牌所属组织进行授权。

payload.name: PaidSync
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PaidSync lets ChatGPT operate your own paid media accounts across 13 platforms from one connection: Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Snapchat, Reddit, Pinterest, Microsoft, and ChatGPT Ads, plus Google Analytics (GA4), Gootle Tag Manager (GTM), Search Console, and Merchant Center. Audit accounts, compare performance across platforms, find wasted spend, draft budget and bid changes, build audiences, and set up conversion tracking. PaidSync changes campaign settings only. It never moves money or processes payments. Every write is drafted for your review, and nothing is applied until you confirm.
payload.longDescription: PaidSync 让 ChatGPT 通过一个连接操作你自己的 13 个平台付费媒体账户：Google Ads、Meta、TikTok、LinkedIn、Snapchat、Reddit、Pinterest、Microsoft 和 ChatGPT Ads，以及 Google Analytics（GA4）、Google Tag Manager（GTM）、Search Console 和 Merchant Center。审计账户、跨平台比较表现、找出浪费支出、起草预算和出价变更、构建受众并设置转化跟踪。PaidSync 只会更改广告系列设置，不会转移资金或处理付款。每次写入都会先起草供你审核，未经确认不会应用。

payload.name: Website Auditor
payload.description: 审查网站与 AI 可见度
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: See whether AI assistants actually recommend your business. Website Auditor puts the questions a real customer would ask to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity, reports which businesses get named in the answers, and adds SEO, security-header, broken-link and performance checks — an overall AI-visibility score (0–100), a per-engine breakdown, competitor comparisons, and ongoing weekly monitoring. The built-in sample report needs no API key and no setup, so you can see exactly what a full report looks like before connecting an account.
payload.longDescription: 了解 AI 助手是否真的会推荐你的企业。Website Auditor 会向 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 和 Perplexity 提出真实客户可能会问的问题，报告回答中提到的企业，并进行 SEO、安全标头、失效链接和性能检查；提供整体 AI 可见度评分（0–100）、各引擎细分、竞争对手比较和持续的每周监测。内置示例报告无需 API 密钥或设置，让你在连接账户前就能准确了解完整报告的样子。

payload.name: La Pyme
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: La Pyme for ChatGPT lets authenticated SMB operators work with their La Pyme account from ChatGPT. Users can inspect sales, stock, products, contact summaries, purchases, payments, transfers, purchase orders, reports, and public API contracts, and can run bounded business workflows such as creating sales, customers, purchases, payments, transfers, and draft purchase orders. Contact tools minimize personal identifiers by default; when the user explicitly requests customer/provider identifiers or uses authorized API read tools, responses may include operational PII such as email, phone, tax ID, or address. The app avoids collecting restricted personal data such as health, biometric, social security, or full payment-card data, and redacts auth/request/card metadata from model-visible tool responses.
payload.longDescription: ChatGPT 版 La Pyme 让经过身份验证的中小企业运营者从 ChatGPT 操作其 La Pyme 账户。用户可以查看销售、库存、产品、联系人摘要、采购、付款、转账、采购订单、报告和公共 API 合约，并执行范围受限的业务流程，例如创建销售、客户、采购、付款、转账和采购订单草稿。联系人工具默认尽量减少个人标识符；当用户明确请求客户/供应商标识符，或使用获授权的 API 读取工具时，回复可能包含电子邮件、电话、税号或地址等运营个人信息。应用不会收集健康、生物特征、社会保障号码或完整支付卡数据等受限个人数据，并会从模型可见的工具回复中删除身份验证、请求和卡片元数据。

payload.name: Dcipher Analytics
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Dcipher is a research and analytics platform that collects large volumes of external content — web, news, social media, your own files — and turns it into structured, analyzable data. This connector gives ChatGPT access to your Dcipher workspace, so you can work through the whole platform in conversation.

ChatGPT can run research agents, build and manage knowledge bases, search them and answer questions with references back to source documents, and set up Insight Boosters, Dcipher's insight and foresight analytics engine. It can produce content landscapes, trend radar charts, comparison matrices, scenario analysis views and write reports from your sources, and schedule workflows so everything stays current.

You describe what you want to know. ChatGPT figures out which parts of Dcipher get you there — whether that means collecting new material, querying what you already have, or building a dashboard on top of it.
payload.longDescription:
Dcipher 是一个研究与分析平台，可收集大量外部内容——网络、新闻、社交媒体和你自己的文件——并将其转化为结构化、可分析的数据。此连接器让 ChatGPT 访问你的 Dcipher 工作区，使你能通过对话使用整个平台。

ChatGPT 可以运行研究智能体、构建和管理知识库、搜索知识库并以源文档为依据回答问题，还可设置 Dcipher 的洞察与前瞻分析引擎 Insight Boosters。它可以生成内容全景、趋势雷达图、比较矩阵、情景分析视图，并根据你的来源撰写报告，还能安排工作流以保持信息最新。

你只需描述想了解什么。ChatGPT 会确定如何利用 Dcipher 的功能来实现目标——无论是收集新资料、查询现有内容，还是在此基础上构建仪表板。

payload.name: Ad Superpowers
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ad Superpowers connects ChatGPT to the advertising and analytics accounts a marketer already runs: Meta Ads, Google Ads, Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, Google Merchant Center, LinkedIn Ads and TikTok Ads.

Read workflows: pull campaign results across platforms and compare them, find which creatives are fatiguing, check why a campaign stopped spending, reconcile conversion numbers that differ between a platform and GA4, compare paid keywords against organic Search Console queries, and audit a Tag Manager container before a release.

Write workflows: pause or adjust a campaign that is overspending, fix a wrong landing-page URL on a live ad without losing its social proof, duplicate a winning ad into a new variant, upload creative assets, and build a new ad. Write tools that publish are gated behind an explicit plan-and-confirm step, so the user reads what will change and confirms it before anything is created.

Every account is connected by the customer through OAuth in the Ad Superpowers dashboard. The app only reaches accounts that customer has connected, and tools for platforms they have not connected are not offered at all.
payload.longDescription:
Ad Superpowers 将 ChatGPT 连接到营销人员已在使用的广告及分析账户：Meta Ads、Google Ads、Google Analytics 4、Google Search Console、Google Tag Manager、Google Merchant Center、LinkedIn Ads 和 TikTok Ads。

读取流程：获取并比较各平台营销活动结果，查找哪些创意出现疲劳，检查营销活动为何停止花费，核对平台与GA4不一致的转化数字，将付费关键词与自然流量的 Search Console 查询进行比较，并在发布前审计 Tag Manager 容器。

写入流程：暂停或调整超支的营销活动，在保留社交认可信息的同时修复在线广告中错误的落地页URL，将表现优秀的广告复制为新变体，上传创意素材，以及创建新广告。涉及发布的写入工具必须经过明确的规划和确认步骤，让用户先阅读将发生的变更并确认，再创建任何内容。

客户通过 Ad Superpowers 仪表盘中的OAuth连接每个账户。应用仅能访问该客户已连接的账户，未连接平台的工具完全不会提供。

payload.name: Roe
payload.description: 借助 AI 调查数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Roe helps fraud, AML, dispute, and compliance teams investigate organization data, run governed agents, review jobs, query tables, and work with policies and knowledge bases.
payload.longDescription: Roe 帮助欺诈、AML、争议处理和合规团队调查组织数据、运行受治理的智能体、审核作业、查询表格，并使用政策和知识库。

payload.name: CE Cosmos Deep Dive
payload.description: 细粒度访问 CE 数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Cosmos brings Consumer Edge's transaction data directly into ChatGPT. Ask questions in plain English and get analyst-grade answers built on near-real-time spend data from millions of US credit and debit cards, covering thousands of brands and merchants — weeks ahead of company reporting. Work directly with transaction-level data to build custom cohorts, run price-point analyses, and answer questions aggregates can't.

Each question runs through Cosmos, Consumer Edge's AI analytics engine, which selects the right metrics, handles panel weighting and merchant hierarchies, and returns a structured summary with the underlying data. Results come back as queryable tables, so ChatGPT can run follow-up analysis, calculate custom metrics, or build charts without re-querying.


Key features:

Natural language querying — no SQL or schema knowledge required; ask about brands, tickers, or merchant groups directly

Full KPI coverage — spend, transactions, average ticket, unique shoppers, visit frequency, and new customer acquisition

Demographic and cohort breakdowns — segment any brand's performance by customer income cohort

Flexible time grains — daily, monthly, or quarterly trends, including quarter-to-date reads on partial periods

Analyst-ready output — answers flag accelerations, decelerations, calendar shifts, and partial-month caveats automatically

Use it to:

Track brand performance ahead of earnings — monthly and quarter-to-date spend growth versus prior periods

Run competitive benchmarking — compare KPIs and market share shifts across any set of brands

Analyze customer behavior — see where new customer growth comes from and whether cohorts are trading down

Spot inflection points — decompose month-over-month changes into customer count, frequency, and ticket drivers

Requires a Consumer Edge subscription with MCP access enabled.
payload.longDescription:
Cosmos 将 Consumer Edge 的交易数据直接带入 ChatGPT。用自然语言提问，即可基于数百万张美国信用卡和借记卡、覆盖数千品牌和商家的近实时消费数据，获得分析师级答案，通常比公司报告提前数周。直接使用交易级数据构建自定义群组、进行价格点分析，并回答聚合数据无法回答的问题。

每个问题都通过 Cosmos（Consumer Edge 的 AI 分析引擎）运行，由引擎选择正确指标、处理样本面板加权和商户层级，并返回带底层数据的结构化摘要。结果以可查询表格返回，因此 ChatGPT 可以执行后续分析、计算自定义指标或制作图表，无需再次查询。

主要功能：

自然语言查询——无需 SQL 或模式知识，直接询问品牌、股票代码或商户群组

完整 KPI 覆盖——支出、交易、平均客单价、独立购物者、到访频率和新客获取

人口统计和群组拆分——按客户收入群组细分任意品牌表现

灵活时间粒度——日、月或季度趋势，包括不完整期间的季度至今数据

适合分析师的输出——自动标记加速、放缓、日历偏移和月中不完整数据注意事项

可用于：

在财报前跟踪品牌表现——比较各期月度及季度至今支出增长

竞争基准分析——比较任意品牌集合的 KPI 和市场份额变化

分析客户行为——了解新客户增长来源，以及各群组是否降级消费

发现拐点——将月环比变化分解为客户数、频率和客单价驱动因素

需要启用 MCP 访问权限的 Consumer Edge 订阅。

payload.name: LLM Pulse
payload.description: 追踪 AI 品牌曝光度
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: LLM Pulse helps teams monitor how their brands, competitors, prompts, and sources appear across AI answers. Use it to explore visibility, mentions, citations, sentiment, recommendations, and traffic signals from your LLM Pulse workspace directly in ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: LLM Pulse 帮助团队监测其品牌、竞争对手、提示词和来源在 AI 回答中的呈现情况。你可以直接在 ChatGPT 中通过 LLM Pulse 工作区查看曝光度、提及、引用、情绪倾向、建议和流量信号。

payload.name: Ratiba
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ratiba helps safari operators and travel teams manage proposal workflows in ChatGPT. The app can find and create clients, search accommodations and destination imagery, create and update itinerary proposals, inspect proposal details and pricing, and translate proposal content for client delivery.
payload.longDescription: Ratiba 帮助 Safari 运营商和旅游团队在 ChatGPT 中管理提案工作流。该应用可查找和创建客户、搜索住宿和目的地图片、创建和更新行程提案、查看提案详情和价格，并翻译提案内容以交付给客户。

payload.name: Ausschreibungsagenten.de
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ausschreibungsagenten.de searches current public procurement notices for the German-speaking market and the wider EU. It covers German federal above- and below-threshold notices through service.bund.de and Datenservice Öffentlicher Einkauf, all 27 EU member states including Germany and Austria through TED, and the United Kingdom through Find a Tender and Contracts Finder. Users can filter by keyword, buyer country, CPV code, deadline window and contract value, open a single notice in full, read a labelled AI summary in German or English, check which portals are connected and how fresh each one is, and see which countries currently hold the most open procedures. Built for contractors, agencies and bid teams in Germany, Austria and Switzerland. Every result carries the link to the authoritative original notice, which always prevails over anything shown here.
payload.longDescription: Ausschreibungsagenten.de 搜索德语市场及更广泛欧盟地区的当前公共采购公告。它通过 service.bund.de 和 Datenservice Öffentlicher Einkauf 覆盖德国联邦高于及低于采购门槛的公告，通过 TED 覆盖包括德国和奥地利在内的全部 27 个欧盟成员国，并通过 Find a Tender 和 Contracts Finder 覆盖英国。用户可按关键词、采购方国家、CPV 代码、截止日期范围和合同金额筛选，打开单条公告全文，阅读明确标注的德语或英语 AI 摘要，查看已连接的门户及各门户的数据新鲜度，并了解哪些国家目前有最多开放中的采购程序。专为德国、奥地利和瑞士的承包商、代理机构和投标团队打造。每项结果都附有权威原始公告链接，原始公告始终优先于这里显示的任何内容。

payload.name: Slipa
payload.description: 将屏幕录制转成演示视频
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Slipa turns a rough screen recording into a finished demo video. It transcribes what you said, rewrites it as a clean script, re-voices it with a narrator in any of twenty-nine languages, and renders the result with your logo, brand colours and captions. The narration language is independent of the recording language, so you can record once and publish in another. Ask for a video and Slipa tells you what it will cost before it spends anything.
payload.longDescription: Slipa 可将粗略的屏幕录制转换为完成度高的演示视频。它会转写你说的话，将其改写为流畅脚本，由旁白以二十九种语言中的任一种重新配音，并为成片添加你的标志、品牌颜色和字幕。旁白语言与录制语言互不依赖，因此你可以录制一次，再用另一种语言发布。请求生成视频时，Slipa 会先告知费用，然后才会产生任何支出。

payload.name: Postify
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Postify is a social media scheduling tool for teams: one calendar for the accounts you publish to, with drafts, scheduling, and delivery analytics in one place. The Postify plugin lets ChatGPT work that calendar with you: list posts and open a specific one, see which channels are connected, draft a new post, move a scheduled post to a different time, search your media library for an image you already uploaded, ask for a suggested posting time, publish a post immediately, or delete one. It can also pull performance figures for posts already delivered, and search Postify's own documentation when you need to know how something works.

Access runs through OAuth 2.1 with PKCE, and issued tokens are bound to the Postify MCP endpoint. You choose scopes on the consent screen, and a tool whose scope you did not grant is never registered for the session, so the assistant cannot see it. Connected apps are listed in Settings and can be revoked there, and every tool call is written to an audit log you can read in the app.

The two irreversible actions — publishing and deleting — are deliberately gated twice. First, an organization setting controls whether an AI assistant may perform them at all, and that setting can only be turned on by a person inside Postify; no AI credential carries the scope needed to enable it. Second, with the setting on, the first call returns a confirmation request with a short-lived token bound to the exact arguments, which must be echoed back on a second call before anything is published or deleted. Expect that first response — it is the safety step working, not an error.
payload.longDescription:
Postify 是面向团队的社交媒体排程工具：通过一个日历管理您发布内容的账户，并在一处管理草稿、排期和发布分析。Postify 插件让 ChatGPT 与您共同管理该日历：列出帖子并打开特定帖子、查看已连接的渠道、起草新帖子、将已排期帖子改到其他时间、在媒体库中搜索已上传的图片、询问建议的发布时间、立即发布帖子或删除帖子。它还可以提取已发布帖子的效果数据，并在您想了解某项功能时搜索 Postify 自有文档。

访问通过 OAuth 2.1 和 PKCE 实现，颁发的令牌绑定到 Postify MCP 端点。您可以在授权页面选择权限范围；未获授权的工具不会注册到会话中，因此助手无法看到它。已连接应用会列在“设置”中，您可在那里撤销连接；每次工具调用都会写入审计日志，您可以在应用中查阅。

两项不可撤销的操作——发布和删除——特意设置了双重门控。首先，组织设置决定 AI 助手是否可以执行这些操作，且只有 Postify 内的人员可以启用该设置；任何 AI 凭证都不具备启用它所需的权限范围。其次，启用后，首次调用会返回确认请求及一个短时有效、绑定到确切参数的令牌；必须在第二次调用中原样回传该令牌，才会执行发布或删除。首次响应是安全机制正常工作的表现，并非错误。

payload.name: Optmyzr
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Optmyzr helps advertisers and agencies inspect linked ad-account performance, opportunities, analytics, alerts, and workspace data; find product guidance; create monitoring routines; and prepare or apply reviewable keyword and negative-keyword changes from ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Optmyzr 帮助广告主和代理机构查看已关联广告账户的表现、机会、分析数据、提醒和工作区数据；查找产品指导；创建监控例程；并通过 ChatGPT 准备或应用可审核的关键词和否定关键词更改。

payload.name: Mailrith
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Mailrith helps users review Subscribers and email results, prepare and deliver Broadcasts, and manage Sequences, Automations, targeting, and email Templates in one connected workspace.
payload.longDescription: Mailrith 帮助用户在一个已连接的工作区中查看订阅者和邮件效果、准备并发送群发邮件，以及管理邮件序列、自动化流程、定向设置和邮件模板。

payload.name: Billy Grace Insights
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Billy Grace Insights lets marketers ask questions about their own campaign performance in plain language. Users can look up which accounts they have access to, discover the metrics, dimensions, and conversion events available for a dataset, and then fetch aggregated marketing, shopping, or keyword performance rows for a date range. Results can be broken down by dimensions such as channel, campaign, or product, and can be recalculated under different attribution models, attribution windows, and lookback windows so users can compare how each model reports the same period. The app only reads data the signed-in user is already authorised to see.
payload.longDescription: Billy Grace Insights 让营销人员用日常语言询问自己的广告活动表现。用户可以查找自己有权访问的账户，了解某个数据集可用的指标、维度和转化事件，然后获取指定日期范围内汇总的营销、购物或关键词表现数据行。结果可按渠道、广告活动或产品等维度细分，并可在不同归因模型、归因窗口和回溯窗口下重新计算，让用户比较各模型如何报告同一时期的数据。应用仅读取已登录用户已经获准查看的数据。

payload.name: Unify
payload.description: 发现、丰富并编排潜在客户
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect Unify to ChatGPT and Codex to run your outbound end to end: build target lists, enrich contacts with verified emails and phone numbers, draft personalized sequences, and sync it all back to your CRM. Then ask what's working: reply rates by sequence, rep activity, and conversion.

Try asking "Find champions from my customer accounts who recently started new roles, get their verified emails and mobile numbers, and draft a sequence," or "Show me the breakdown of tasks completed by reps over the last 30 days."

Unify searches 1.1B+ people and 65M+ companies across 40+ data providers. Find, enrich, and sequence prospects in one chat.
payload.longDescription:
将 Unify 连接到 ChatGPT 和 Codex，端到端开展外联工作：建立目标名单、补充经过验证的电子邮件地址和电话号码、起草个性化触达序列，并将所有内容同步回 CRM。之后还可以询问哪些做法有效：各序列的回复率、销售代表的活动情况和转化表现。

可以尝试提问：“找出我的客户账户中最近转任新职位的关键联系人，获取他们经过验证的电子邮件地址和手机号码，并起草一组触达消息”；或者“显示销售代表过去 30 days 完成任务的明细”。

Unify 可搜索 1.1B+ 位人士和 65M+ 家公司，数据覆盖 40+ 个提供商。在一次聊天中发现、补充潜在客户信息并编排触达序列。

payload.name: Brainerce
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Brainerce connects your Brainerce-powered online store to ChatGPT so you can run it in conversation instead of clicking through a dashboard. Check what is in stock, look up and update products, review and fulfil orders, issue and manage discount codes, find customers, and edit storefront content.

The connection is bound to a single store and to the permissions you grant when you sign in. An assistant given read-only access cannot change anything, and it can never reach another merchant's store. Actions that modify or delete data are marked as such, so ChatGPT asks before running them.

This app manages catalogues of physical goods. It does not sell digital products or subscriptions, and it does not process payments or transfer funds through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription:
Brainerce 将由 Brainerce 驱动的在线商店连接至 ChatGPT，让你通过对话运营商店，无需在仪表板中逐项点击。查看库存、查询和更新产品、审核和履行订单、发放和管理折扣码、查找客户，以及编辑店面内容。

连接绑定到单个商店，并受你登录时授予的权限约束。仅获只读权限的助手无法更改任何内容，也绝不能访问其他商家的商店。修改或删除数据的操作会有相应标记，因此 ChatGPT 会在执行前询问。

本应用管理实物商品目录。它不销售数字产品或订阅，也不通过 ChatGPT 处理付款或转移资金。

payload.name: GoCodes
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: This plugin allows you to harness the power of AI while working with your GoCodes Asset & Inventory data. Now you can use AI chat to answer questions like 'Where's my nearest compressor?', 'What tasks do I need to work on today?' and much more. On your smartphone you can now talk to GoCodes using just your voice ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 此插件可让你在使用 GoCodes 资产和库存数据时借助 AI。现在，你可以通过 AI 聊天询问“离我最近的压缩机在哪里？”、“我今天需要处理哪些任务？”等问题。在智能手机上，你还可以直接用语音通过 ChatGPT 与 GoCodes 对话。

payload.name: Whatalo
payload.description: 管理你的 Whatalo 商店
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Whatalo connects ChatGPT to a merchant's store so users can review store information, products, categories, inventory, customers, and orders. It also supports controlled catalog updates, inventory adjustments, product image uploads, and order status changes through the merchant's authorized Whatalo account.
payload.longDescription: Whatalo 将 ChatGPT 连接到商家的商店，让用户查看商店信息、商品、类别、库存、客户和订单。它还支持通过商家授权的 Whatalo 账户，以受控方式更新目录、调整库存、上传商品图片和更改订单状态。

payload.name: Rubikc
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Rubikc helps authenticated storefront teams inspect and manage storefront content, navigation, collections, files, source materials, onboarding, and analytics through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Rubikc 帮助已通过身份验证的店面团队通过 ChatGPT 查看和管理店面内容、导航、商品集合、文件、源材料、入门流程及分析数据。

payload.name: Leni
payload.description: 房地产数据与背景信息
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use Leni’s intelligent runtime to answer real-estate, financial, operating, market-research, and organizational questions from your authorized data and durable context. Read portfolio metrics, analyze performance, consult relevant memory, and explicitly save durable preferences while keeping results scoped to your Leni account, organization, and authorized properties. Leni connects to supported property-management and data systems and provides a single runtime for highly accurate, context-aware answers. Learn more or connect your data at https://leni.co/request-demo/.
payload.longDescription: 使用 Leni 的智能运行时，根据你获授权的数据和持久化上下文回答房地产、财务、运营、市场研究和组织相关问题。读取投资组合指标、分析表现、查阅相关记忆，并在将结果限定于你的 Leni 账户、组织和获授权房产的前提下，明确保存持久化偏好。Leni 连接受支持的物业管理和数据系统，为高准确度、具备上下文感知的回答提供统一运行时。你可以在 https://leni.co/request-demo/ 了解更多或连接数据。

payload.name: Laurel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Laurel is the AI timekeeping and work intelligence platform built for professional services firms. This plugin brings that work into ChatGPT, so knowledge workers can review their day without leaving the conversation. Retrieve the time entries and activities Laurel captured throughout the day, and see where billable time went. Summarize work by client, matter, or application, and spot the gaps between what got done and what's been recorded. Turn that activity into billing narratives, ready for an end-of-day or weekly review. Access stays tied to your Laurel account throughout.
payload.longDescription: Laurel 是面向专业服务公司的 AI 工时记录与工作洞察平台。该插件将工作带入 ChatGPT，让知识工作者无需离开对话即可回顾一天的工作。检索 Laurel 全天记录的工时条目和活动，了解计费工时的去向。按客户、事项或应用汇总工作，并找出已完成工作与记录内容之间的差距。将活动转化为账单说明，方便在日末或每周回顾时使用。访问权限始终与你的 Laurel 账户绑定。

payload.name: Everlaw
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Everlaw provides a secure, standardized Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that allows OpenAI to connect to Everlaw and work with live matter data on behalf of an authenticated user.

Through the connector, a connected agent can understand a user’s Everlaw project structure, translate natural-language requests into Everlaw search logic, retrieve responsive documents and document text, and analyze metadata and Bates driven result sets. The connected agent can also support natural-language reporting and analysis workflows, while Everlaw remains the governed evidence layer and system of record for case materials, metadata, and work product.

Access to Deep Dive via this connector complements search and retrieval tools, as well as Everlaw’s native Deep Dive experience. It is intended to support broader, semantic, evidence-backed questions while preserving Everlaw’s permissions and the integrity of the underlying matter record.

The connector is designed to operate within the user’s existing Everlaw permission level. Every request is authenticated and authorized against the user’s Everlaw permissions, so the agent can access only the projects, documents, and data that user is already permitted to view. Deep Dive will also be available through the connector, allowing a user to query Deep Dive over eligible Everlaw project data and retrieve evidence-backed results without changing the underlying matter record.

Using the connector, an agent can:

Use Deep Dive to ask broader investigative questions and return evidence-backed results, once the Deep Dive tools are available.

Convert a natural-language request into a structured Everlaw search. 

Generate structured reports about project contents, document volumes, custodians, dates, Bates ranges, and other returned data. 

Search by document text, metadata, Bates or Control number, binder, coding, redactions, productions, processing criteria, and other supported terms. 

Identify the metadata fields, datasets, and processed uploads available in a project. 

Retrieve matching documents with Bates numbers, metadata, review links, document-text links, and extracted values. 

Summarize and analyze retrieved documents or result sets in natural language.

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Noah Predict helps users investigate public signals, assess risk and trends, commission durable research, retrieve evidence-backed results, continue an investigation, and create client-ready research artifacts.
payload.longDescription: Noah Predict 帮助用户调查公开信号、评估风险和趋势、委托持久化研究、获取有证据支持的结果、继续调查，并创建面向客户的研究成果。

payload.name: BITZER Gascooler Tool
payload.description: 评估并选择气体冷却器
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: BITZER Gascooler Tool rates released R744 gas-cooler models, selects models for a required capacity, retrieves validated R744 saturation limits, and creates localized PDF, STEP, 3D, dimensional-drawing, pinch-diagram, and capacity-map artifacts in SI units. The app never substitutes estimated engineering values when calculation data, traces, released geometry, or rendering dependencies are unavailable.
payload.longDescription: BITZER Gascooler Tool对已发布的R744气体冷却器型号进行性能评估，为所需容量选择型号，检索经过验证的R744饱和界限，并以SI单位生成本地化的PDF、STEP、3D、尺寸图、夹点图和容量图文件。兼容的ChatGPT客户端会收到一个内嵌的多语言结果展示区，其中包含计算输入和输出、PNG预览、交互式3D模型、警告、必须展示的暂定数据说明、到期状态和安全的临时下载。当计算数据、计算追踪记录、已发布的几何模型或渲染依赖不可用时，应用绝不会用估算的工程数值替代。

payload.name: Goodword
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Businesses run on relationships. Your next deal, hire, client, or introduction starts with someone already in your network.

Goodword brings together your LinkedIn network, email and calendar history, and the private context behind each relationship, so ChatGPT can help you find the right people, understand why they matter, and act at the right moment.

Search your direct and extended network, pull enriched profiles and relationship history, and find warm paths to people you want to reach. Turn meeting debriefs into notes, reminders, and follow-ups. Manage introductions and groups, and see who you should reconnect with next.

A CRM manages contacts. LinkedIn gives you connections. Goodword helps you use the relationships you’ve already built to find clients, make key hires, raise capital, and get the introductions that move your business forward.

Requires a Goodword account. Access is scoped to your network through OAuth.
payload.longDescription:
商业建立在关系之上。下一笔交易、下一位员工、客户或引荐，往往始于你现有人脉中的某个人。

Goodword 汇总你的 LinkedIn 人脉、邮件和日历记录，以及每段关系背后的私人背景，让 ChatGPT 帮你找到合适的人、理解他们的重要性，并在恰当时机采取行动。

搜索直接和扩展人脉，获取丰富的个人资料与关系历史，找到联系目标人物的暖介绍路径。把会议复盘变成笔记、提醒和跟进。管理引荐和群组，查看下一步该与谁重新联系。

CRM 管理联系人，LinkedIn 提供连接；Goodword 帮你利用已经建立的关系寻找客户、招募关键人才、筹集资金，并获得推动业务发展的引荐。

需要 Goodword 账户。通过 OAuth 将访问范围限定在你的人脉网络内。

payload.name: Harvey
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The Harvey plugin connects ChatGPT to Harvey's AI-powered legal intelligence platform. It supports three core capabilities: (1) General legal inquiries grounded in Harvey's legal knowledge; (2) Analysis and search over your firm's Vault projects — saved work product, memos, and prior documents; (3) Targeted research using specialized knowledge sources, such as UK Tax legislation and HMRC manuals. Discovery tools let users list available Vault projects and knowledge sources. All tools are read-only and operate strictly within the authenticated user's Harvey permissions. Access requires a Harvey account with an active license and the MCP feature enabled by your workspace admin.
payload.longDescription: Harvey 插件将 ChatGPT 连接到 Harvey 的 AI 法律智能平台，支持三项核心能力：(1) 基于 Harvey 法律知识的常规法律咨询；(2) 搜索和分析你所在律所 Vault 项目中的已保存工作成果、备忘录和历史文件；(3) 使用英国税法和 HMRC 手册等专业知识源开展定向研究。发现工具可列出可用 Vault 项目和知识源。所有工具均为只读，并严格遵循已认证用户的 Harvey 权限。需要 Harvey 账户、有效许可，以及工作区管理员启用 MCP 功能。

payload.name: Salesforce
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Reimagine your sales workflow with Salesforce and ChatGPT. Get CRM context on every deal directly in ChatGPT, so reps can research, plan, and close faster. Then, enrich Salesforce with the key insights so you and your team can make smarter decisions.

From pipeline updates to account research, it gives you the clarity, speed, and guidance you need to close more deals with confidence.
payload.longDescription:
与 Salesforce 和 ChatGPT 一起重新构想你的销售工作流。直接在 ChatGPT 中获取每笔交易的 CRM 背景信息，帮助销售代表更快地调研、规划并成交。然后将关键洞察补充到 Salesforce 中，让你和团队做出更明智的决策。

从销售渠道更新到客户账户调研，它都能提供所需的清晰信息、速度和指导，帮助你更有把握地赢得更多交易。

payload.name: ChatGPT Admin
payload.description: 为工作空间所有者或管理员管理 ChatGPT 工作空间。
payload.summaryOriginal: Manage ChatGPT workspaces for workspace owners or admins.
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Manage workspace members, groups, roles, billing, usage limits, and increase requests; analyze workspace and Codex usage. Supports credit-based and native USD workspaces: read balance_unit, use explicitly tagged USD amount inputs, and never convert credits into native USD. Actions respect the signed-in user's workspace permissions.
payload.longDescription: 管理工作空间成员、群组、角色、账单、使用限额和额度增加申请；分析工作空间及 Codex 使用情况。支持按额度计费和原生 USD 工作空间：读取 balance_unit，使用明确标记为 USD 的金额输入，绝不要将额度换算为原生 USD。所有操作均遵循已登录用户的工作空间权限。

payload.name: Page Pulse
payload.description: 跟踪搜索引擎优化和页面变更
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Page Pulse combines Google Search Console data, Google Analytics 4 data, and on-page change tracking for the user's own websites. Through ChatGPT, users can list their tracked projects, investigate traffic drops by comparing analytics periods, see exactly what changed on their pages (content, titles, meta descriptions, links) and when, analyze the search queries driving traffic, start tracking new sites or hand-picked page lists, and set up email or Slack alerts for meaningful page changes or traffic thresholds.
payload.longDescription: Page Pulse整合了用户自有网站的Google Search Console数据、Google Analytics 4数据以及页面变更追踪功能。通过ChatGPT，用户可列出已追踪项目、通过对比分析周期调查流量下降原因、精确查看页面内容/标题/元描述/链接等具体变更内容及时间、分析引流搜索关键词、新增网站或自选页面清单的追踪功能，并为关键页面变更或流量阈值设置邮件或Slack警报。

payload.name: Controlle
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
O Controlle é uma plataforma de gestão financeira para pequenas e médias empresas brasileiras, com foco no setor de serviços.

Com este plugin, você acessa o financeiro da sua empresa direto na conversa. Consulte saldo por conta, contas a pagar e a receber por período, lançamentos por categoria e a projeção de fluxo de caixa. Também é possível registrar novos lançamentos e atualizar informações, sempre com confirmação antes de gravar.

Exemplos de uso: "quanto tenho a pagar essa semana?", "como ficou meu fluxo de caixa em julho?", "quais clientes estão em atraso?", "lance uma despesa de energia de R$ 1.200 com vencimento dia 15".

É necessário ter uma conta ativa no Controlle. No primeiro uso, você conecta sua conta e autoriza o acesso.
payload.longDescription:
Controlle 是面向巴西中小企业、重点服务行业的财务管理平台。

通过插件可在对话中查询账户余额、按期间查看应付和应收账款、按类别查看记录以及现金流预测，也可登记和更新记录，写入前始终需要确认。

示例：“我这周要付多少钱？”、“7 月现金流怎么样？”、“哪些客户逾期？”、“登记一笔 R$ 1.200 的电费，15 日到期。”

需要有效的 Controlle 账户。首次使用时需连接账户并授权访问。

payload.name: Magister Marketing
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Magister Marketing connects your brand's marketing workspace to ChatGPT. Review your brand profile and marketing plan, then work the plan item by item: read the next prioritized task with its full brief, record progress notes, and update item status as work ships.

Track AI visibility and GEO. See how ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews answer the prompts your buyers actually ask about your category, start new scoring rounds, and open an interactive report showing score trends across rounds, results by AI model, and per-prompt detail.

Run SEO and answer-engine audits with per-channel health scores, research keywords with search volume and difficulty, and review Google Ads, Meta Ads, and TikTok Ads performance. Draft and schedule social posts from your brand voice, pull per-post and follower analytics, discover influencers by channel and topic, work with project assets and files, monitor public sources for brand mentions, and open pull requests against a connected GitHub repository.

Writes are scoped and audited. Publishing a post, sending an email, merging a pull request, and deleting a file each stop at an explicit confirmation or a server-side approval that a person must grant in the Magister app before anything happens. New ad campaigns are created paused on Meta or TikTok, and this connector has no way to activate a campaign or begin ad spend. Requires a Magister account.
payload.longDescription:
Magister Marketing 将品牌营销工作区连接到 ChatGPT。查看品牌资料和营销计划，然后逐项执行计划：读取下一项优先任务及完整简报，记录进展笔记，并在工作完成时更新项目状态。

追踪 AI 可见度和 GEO。查看 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、Perplexity 和 Google AI Overviews 如何回答买家对你所在品类实际提出的问题，开始新一轮评分，并打开交互式报告，查看各轮评分趋势、各 AI 模型结果和每个提示词的详情。

运行 SEO 和答案引擎审计，查看各渠道健康评分；研究带搜索量和难度的关键词；审查 Google Ads、Meta Ads 和 TikTok Ads 表现。以品牌声音起草并安排社交帖子，获取每条帖子和粉丝分析，按渠道和主题发现影响者，使用项目资产和文件，监测公开来源中的品牌提及，并针对已连接的 GitHub 仓库创建拉取请求。

所有写入操作都受范围限制并经过审计。发布帖子、发送邮件、合并拉取请求和删除文件，都会在实际发生前停留在明确确认步骤，或等待人工在 Magister 应用中授予服务器端批准。Meta 或 TikTok 上创建的新广告活动会以暂停状态创建，此连接器无法启用活动或开始广告支出。需要 Magister 账户。

payload.name: MCLogs
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: MCLogs lets users look up public maritime shipment tracking information by container number or Bill of Lading. It returns the current status, route, estimated dates, vessel and voyage details, Telex Release status, and available event history. This version does not provide invoice access and does not require an MCLogs account or authentication.
payload.longDescription: MCLogs 可让用户通过集装箱编号或提单查询公开的海运货物追踪信息。它会返回当前状态、路线、预计日期、船舶和航次详情、电放状态以及可用的事件历史记录。此版本不提供发票访问权限，也无需 MCLogs 账户或身份验证。

payload.name: PredictLeads
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Give your AI assistant structured intelligence on millions of companies worldwide. Data sourced directly from company websites, career pages, news outlets, SEC filings, and review sites. Continuously refreshed, with 5+ years of history.

Every API endpoint is a native tool: ask natural-language questions, get structured answers.

- Enrich known companies by domain name: news, job postings, technographics, key customers, lookalikes.
- Discover net new companies by criteria: technologies used, hiring activity, funding received and more. Filtered by location, size, and industry.

Signal types: News Events (launches, partnerships, leadership changes...), Job Openings (with salaries, seniority, locations), Technology Detections, Financing Events, Similar Companies, SEC Filings (as Markdown), Product offerings, Key Customers, and GitHub Activity.

Built for GTM teams, researchers, and investors running agentic workflows that need live, structured company data.

- Enrich known companies by domain name: news, job postings, technographics, key customers, lookalikes.
